rationale: The XDriver project is licensed under Apache-2.0 (OSI-approved permissive license). Root LICENCE file and setup.py both declare Apache-2.0. The bundled playwright-core fork (turnstilebrowser-playwright-core v1.49.0) also uses Apache-2.0 per its package.json and bundled LICENSE. The NOTICE file acknowledges Playwright (Microsoft) and Puppeteer (Google) as upstream sources under Apache-2.0. ThirdPartyNotices.txt lists 48 transitive dependencies, all under permissive licenses (MIT, BSD-3-Clause, ISC). No copyleft or proprietary constraints identified. All license texts are present and verifiable in the repository.
